annotations.title: Where this server's data comes from

description: Where this server's data comes from and how far to trust it. For each kind of data: who publishes it and a link, whether it is an official record (only data its publisher published and BetaNYC did not modify is; data BetaNYC modified or produced is not), how it was gathered, what BetaNYC did to it (for example cleaned it, matched it to addresses, joined it with other data, or counted it), how current it is on this server, what it covers and what is missing, the terms of use and the credit line to print, where to check a figure at the official record, where to report an error (to BetaNYC when BetaNYC modified or produced the data, to the publisher for the original records, and to this server's issues for a bug), which tools use it, and corrections that touched it. Call it whenever someone asks where an answer comes from, how current or accurate it is, or how to check or cite it. topic narrows it to one kind of data, or to the data behind one tool (give the tool's name). For who built this server, use about_betanyc. Topics on this server: spending, contracts, budget, payroll, revenue, nycedc-contracts, nycha-contracts, smart-search.

topic.description: One kind of data (a source id), or a tool name for the data behind that tool. Any case. Default: all.
